## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL with mixed style (no clear Growth vs Value leadership). Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmations: (1) broad sector participation (7/11 positive) and (2) major stock divergences among big caps (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, MSFT) — suppresses a stronger regime call. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors represented in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Discretionary lead: AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%), BKNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +5.62%). Communication strong: CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%). Technology showing strength via mega-caps: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -3.24%). Real Estate lagging with pockets of CORRECTION: VTR CORRECTION (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%), WELL CORRECTION (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%). Industrials soft: CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%), UPS BELOW TREND (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -4.86%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%), CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%), ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%), ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%). Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Growth-leaning given Tech/Consumer Disc dominance.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: LIN BELOW TREND (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -10.34%), VTR CORRECTION (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%), WELL CORRECTION (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%), AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%). Weakness concentrated in select Materials/Real Estate and some large-cap Tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: MSFT (1W: +21.75%), CHTR (1W: +17.57%), AMZN (1W: +17.00%), ORCL (1W: +12.94%), NOW (1W: +12.60%) — watch ORCL and GOOGL as short-term RECOVERYs. Major divergence: AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL, ORCL show 1W vs 1M mismatch → MAJOR Divergence, watch for trend break; treat moves as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but active: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) while AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) and NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -2.94% | 1M: +1.60%) show uneven internals; ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%). Sector performance is constructive on the week (Technology 1W: +2.45% | 1M: -2.59%) but internals are mixed.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive but selective: V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.29%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.20% | 1M: +9.88%), JPM in CORRECTION (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +5.78%). Financials show steady 1M strength (Financials 1W: +1.10% | 1M: +5.16%) supporting rotation into cyclicals if sustained.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed defensive signals: JNJ in CORRECTION despite bullish FDA news (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -2.85%). Sector showing modest 1W gains (Healthcare 1W: +0.43% | 1M: +3.63%) but stock-level divergence persists.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and select ABOVE TREND Tech names (MSFT, ACN, AMZN) while reducing exposure to names in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (AAPL, NVDA, AMD, QCOM). Style: growth-leaning but mixed — remain selective given MAJOR Divergence among large caps.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%), GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +11.38% | 1M: -1.41%). BEARISH: AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%), CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%), QCOM BELOW TREND (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +2.28%) and Communication (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +2.73%) — monitor follow-through. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -0.16%) and Real Estate (1W: -2.33% | 1M: +3.04%) for continued weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch MSFT for continuation above recent breakout (ABOVE TREND) as confirmation of tech leadership; watch AAPL failure to regain weekly losses (CORRECTION) as downside trigger; watch QCOM and AMD breaks for further semiconductor weakness (BOTH BELOW TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+80): FDA nod for surgical robotics — JNJ in CORRECTION (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) so news is partially diverging from price (watch for accumulation). BA (+80): 737 MAX 7 certificate — BA RECOVERY (1W: +3.16% | 1M: -1.12%), price confirming the bullish catalyst.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AVGO (-75): EU antitrust loss headline — Broadcom not in the provided detailed price list here but the catalyst is material; monitor price action for confirmation. INTC (-45): China/TSMC pressure — Intel not in detailed subset above; treat news as risk to semiconductor suppliers and watch QCOM/AMD which are BELOW TREND and may reflect sector stress.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (no clear Growth vs Value leadership); Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) show relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR Divergence among large caps (AAPL, NVDA, GOOGL vs MSFT) and several high-profile news catalysts (JNJ, BA, AVGO) require confirmation before shifting regime.
